newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices mixed, volume dives.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices mixed, volume dives.

text.p: Traded volume on the Istanbul gold exchange fell sharply to 980 kilos on Friday from 2,100 kilos on Thursday, due to lack of arbitrage opportunity, dealers said.
Gold prices were mixed, easing in dollar terms to $338.00 an ounce, from $339.00 on Thursday but firming in lira terms to 1,603,000 per gram versus 1,601,000 as the lira weakened against the dollar.
The Turkish currency closed at 147,400 per dollar after 147,000 on Thursday.
Brokers said weak demand after Thursday's heavy trade based mainly on arbitrage deals, as well as expectations that international prices would go further down, lowered volume sharply on Friday.
Most of the day's trade -- 705 kilos -- took place in the morning session with 83.7 percent of the total trade conducted in lira terms.
